chunks: And it is narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb that he said:

I said to him: A man from among your followers, from among their righteous ones, complained to me about what he suffers from sleep. He said to me: I want to rise for salat al-layl, but sleep overcomes me until morning comes. So sometimes I make up my prayer continuously for a month or two, bearing its heaviness with patience.
So he said: By Allah, it is a delight of the eye; by Allah, it is a delight of the eye. And he did not grant permission regarding al-Witr at the beginning of the night.
He said: Making it up during the day is better.

key_terms.أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ: the beginning portion of the night
key_terms.النَّوْمِ: sleep that prevents one from rising for worship
key_terms.الْقَضَاءُ: making up a missed prayer after its time
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: the single-unit concluding prayer of the night prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer performed in the late hours of the night
key_terms.قَضَيْتُ: I made up a missed act of worship

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if sleep overcomes him and he misses salat al-layl?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of one who is overcome by sleep and misses salat al-layl. It indicates the merit of making up the missed night prayer during the day and states that performing its qaḍāʾ by day is better, while not permitting al-Witr at the beginning of the night in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1378 - It is reported from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb that He said:
"I said to him (Abu Abdullah (as)):
'One of your followers, who is among your righteous adherents, complained to me about the difficulty he experiences with sleep. He said to me: ‘I wish to rise for the night prayer (salat al-layl), but sleep overcomes me until I wake up in the morning. Sometimes I make up my prayer continuously for a month or two and endure the difficulty.’
Imam (as) said: 'By Allah (swt), it is a source of delight, by Allah (swt), it is a source of delight!' But he did not permit performing the Witr (single unit of the night prayer) at the beginning of the night.
Imam (as) said: 'Making it up during the day is better.'"
